UI_OMHTT_BarrierTools: Requires a sharp, unbroken knife or cleaver (kept). The tool icon shows one accepted example; saws are not accepted.
UI_OMHTT_Agrees: Local object agrees with authority. Empty state uses condition -1.
UI_OMHTT_Waiting: Local object differs or is still arriving. Inspect again after synchronization.
UI_OMHTT_Denied: Test controls are disabled or you lack permission.
UI_OMHTT_VersionMismatch: Client and authority versions differ. Install the same test package on both.
UI_OMHTT_TooFar: Stand within two tiles on the same floor, then try again.
UI_OMHTT_Unavailable: This tile is unavailable or has no floor.
UI_OMHTT_Inspected: Tile inspected. Reopen this tile's menu to change or remove a device.
UI_OMHTT_Stale: Old request rejected; no change made. Reopen the menu to use the refreshed state.
UI_OMHTT_Occupied: A test device already occupies this tile; no duplicate was created.
UI_OMHTT_Blocked: Choose a clear, nearby floor tile.
UI_OMHTT_Limit: This test world has used all 64 tracked tiles. Reuse a previous tile or use a new test world.
UI_OMHTT_Conflict: Exact object identity is missing or duplicated. No repair or replacement was attempted; report the logs.
UI_OMHTT_Removed: Exact test device removed. Other objects were left alone.
UI_OMHTT_MPCombatDeferred: This combat mutation is SP-only until multiplayer damage/health synchronization is proven.
UI_OMHTT_WrongDevice: This command requires the potato prototype.
UI_OMHTT_Empty: No test rounds remain. Use the explicit debug refill control.
UI_OMHTT_Cooling: Recovering between shots. Wait one real second; no round was spent.
UI_OMHTT_NoTarget: No visible zombie within six tiles. Walls, windows and unloaded tiles block the lane. No round was spent.
UI_OMHTT_Fired: One prototype shot fired. Inspect health/death, impact and remaining rounds. Damage tuning is experimental.
UI_OMHTT_Refilled: Debug test supply set to four rounds; the firing cooldown is unchanged.
UI_OMHTT_Aimed: Only this device's head advanced one of sixteen sprite facings. The base remains fixed.
UI_OMHTT_Dumped: Nearby defense diagnostics written to console.txt.
UI_OMHTT_NotCompared: Request rejected before world-state comparison; no agreement claim.
UI_OMHTT_BarrierRotated: Barrier rotated with its 1x2 footprint. Front and side strikes deal 20 damage; rear strikes deal none.
UI_OMHTT_WrongBarrier: This command requires a barrier prototype.

UI_OMHTT_BarrierPurpose: A wall of spikes, used to keep the undead out.
UI_OMHTT_BarrierRedeploy: Pick up and redeploy this barrier to change its facing.
UI_OMHTT_CollisionLegend: Solid line: collision | Arrow: spike side
UI_OMHTT_ReinforcedBarrierDescription: A reinforced wall of spikes, used to keep the undead out.
UI_OMHTT_TurretDescription: An empty turret base. Install a potato head or supported firearm, then add ammunition and power.
UI_OMHTT_DeployTurretDescription: Place the selected turret with its contents. Pickup preserves supplies.
UI_OMHTT_TurretLoadHint: Drag supplies into the Turret loot container.
UI_OMHTT_ManageHint: Drag items in or out. Right-click a slot to remove its contents.
UI_OMHTT_ManageUnloadFirst: Unload reserve ammo before swapping heads.
UI_OMHTT_ManageCapacityFull: Remove excess ammo or modules first.
UI_OMHTT_InstallMissing: Selected turret is no longer available.
UI_OMHTT_ManageJammed: Remove the gun to clear its jam.
UI_OMHTT_BarbServiceTools: Hammer and pliers. Ten seconds. Removal returns no materials.
UI_OMHTT_BarbTools: Requires a usable hammer and pliers.
UI_OMHTT_BuildRequirements: Crafting requires the normal materials, tools and skills.
UI_OMHTT_BuildPickUp: Pick up the crafted item to place it.
UI_OMHTT_HeadDescription: A potato launcher head for a turret base. Both crafting methods produce the same head.
UI_OMHTT_WireService: Free ten-second repair; five-second pickup. No tools or XP.
UI_OMHTT_BedReinforceRequirements: Carpentry 3, hammer, 1 plank and 4 nails. Reinforces only this tile.
